translation.name: Luda yã takada kũ Bisã yão

content.text: Nɛnɑ nɑ sɑ̃ɑ nge gunɑrun biibii ye yɑ kpiɑ tem tɛɛrɑɔ.
Nɑ mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ nge yɑkɑsun biibii ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ wɔwɑɔ.
ɑ̀ n nɛn kĩnɑsi wɑ win wɔndiɑ kpɑɑsibun wuurɔ,
u rɑ n sɑ̃ɑwɑ nge biibii ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ sɑ̃kin suunu sɔɔ.
ɑ̀ n nɛn kĩnɑsi wɑ ɑluwɑɑsibɑn suunu sɔɔ,
u sɑ̃ɑwɑ nge dɑ̃ɑ te bɑ mɔ̀ pɔmiɛ dɑ̃nun suunu sɔɔ tèn mɑrum mu dibu do.
Nɑ rɑ kɑ̃ nɑ n sɔ̃ win sɑɑrɔ.
U kɑ mɑn dɑ mi bɑ rɑ tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑ dĩɑnu di.
Mɑ u mɑn nɛnuɑ kɑ kĩru.
Wee kĩrɑ mɑn bɑrɔ kuɑ.
A mɑn dɑm kɛ̃ kɑ kirɑ duronu, kɑ pɔmiɛn mɑrum.
Nɑ kĩ nɑ n nɛn wiru sɔndi win nɔm dwɑrɔ,
kpɑ win nɔm geu gu mɑn bɔkɑsi.
bɛɛ Yerusɑlɛmun wɔndiɑbɑ, nɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ
kɑ yɛɛ kpiki kɑ nɛnnun yĩsinu,
i ku nɛn kĩnɑsi yɑmiɑ sɑɑ ye u ǹ kĩ u se.
nɑ nɛn kĩnɑsin nɔɔ nɔɔmɔ.
Wɔɔ u guunu sɑrikirɑmɔ u wee.
U sɑ̃ɑwɑ nge yɑɑ kpiku ǹ kun mɛ nge gini kpɛmɑ.
Wi wee dirun biruɔ,
u mɑn mɛɛrimɑ fɛnɛntin di.
Mɑ u kɑ mɑn gɑri kuɑ u nɛɛ,
ɑ seewo nɛn kĩnɑsi, kurɔ burɔ, ɑ nɑ.
Wee purɑn sɑɑ yɑ doonɑ,
mɑ gurɑ yɑ yɔ̃rɑ.
Biibii yɑ kpiɑ yɑm kpuro.
Sɑ gunɔ bwese bwesekɑn swĩi nɔɔmɔ.
Kpɑrukonun swĩi yi nɔɔrɑ bɛsɛn tem sɔɔ.
Dɑ̃ɑ te bɑ mɔ̀ figie tɑ mɑrum torumɔ,
mɑ resɛm tɔ̃kɑn wɛ̃sun nuburɑ pusɑ.
A seewo, ɑ nɑ nɛn kĩnɑsi, kurɔ burɔ,
wunɛ wi ɑ sɑ̃ɑ nge sɑ̃kusɑ̃ ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ kpee bɑɑ sɔɔ yɑ kukuɑ.
A mɑn wunɛn wuswɑɑ sɔ̃ɔsio.
A de n wunɛn nɔɔ nɔ.
Domi wunɛn dɔkɔrɑ nɔɔbu do.
Mɛyɑ mɑɑ wunɛn wuswɑɑ rɑ mɑn wɛ̃re.
i sun dɛmɑku binu mwɛɛrio
ni nu bɛsɛn resɛm gbɑɑru sɑnkumɔ sɑɑ ye yɑ wɛ̃su sɑ̃ɑ.
nɛn kĩnɑsi u sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɛgii,
nɑ mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ wigii.
U win sɑbenu kpɑrɑmɔ yɑkɑsun biibiin suunu sɔɔ.
A de ɑ gɔsirɑ, nɛn kĩnɑsi, ɑ n wɑ̃ɑ guunu wɔllɔ
ɑ n sɑ̃ɑ nge yɑɑ kpiku ǹ kun mɛ nge gini kpɛmɑ,
sere sɔ̃ɔ u kɑ du sɑɑru tu kpɛ̃ɑ.

content: Kurɔ u kɑ win kĩnɑsi dosimɔ

footnotes.text: gurɑ yɑ yɔ̃rɑ - Isirelibɑn temɔ, purɑn sɑɑ gurɑ rɑ nɛ.
